title: Notifications
description:
Building on an initial dive into Collision, this project explores a practical application of the instrument. Various phone notification sounds were created using Collision, Operator, and Simpler. 

Beyond the sound design itself, it was an exercise in understanding how we perceive certain sounds and the associations we've built around them. An emergency siren isn't going to read as a calendar reminder, no matter how you tweak it.

audio.label: Calendar
audio.desc: A calendar notification. For me, usually a birthday or a bill I forgot about.

audio.label: Emergency
audio.desc: A siren built for immediate attention. Usually an AMBER alert in my case, though I remember getting one in Taiwan when they were testing their inbound missile strike alert.

audio.label: Error
audio.desc: An error or invalid input notification.

audio.label: Ringtone
audio.desc: The classic ringtone. More of a landline thing now that I think about it.

audio.label: Timer
audio.desc: A timer going off. Mine usually means laundry or something in the oven.

audio.label: Wake Up Alarm
audio.desc: A gentle piano alarm. A low-pass filter slowly opens up over time, bringing in a bit more brightness without jolting the listener awake.
